/ [Concern]ing the Quality of the Garments. /
The Living Spirit constructs the universe out of the mixture of darkness and light resulting from the deliberate sacrifice of the five garments or sons of the First Man. This is then held in place by his own five sons. Mani compares the Living Spirit to an architect who builds a palace for a king. This metaphor is then extended: the Father of Life (i.e. the Living Spirit) as a perfect carpenter, and the Ambassador as king in this universe.
